visual_review: Visually reviewed: Produce stall, cucumber baskets, jars, trellis, watering can and residential lane remain coherent. Small blank price cards are retained as shop props; no readable lettering. Bright blue sky, green foliage and neutral daylight read clearly as midday. No people, mascot, large clock board, neighborhood plaque, time/date text or UI. Foreground remains available for a separate character layer. Some distant street lamps remain faintly warm in daylight.
